FixItem.description: A chosen Item Card always spawns

RefreshShop.description: Restock wares; cost doubles each time

UpgradeItemStats.description: All Item Cards +3 to their values

Attribute.description: Start: draw 2 weighted stat items, repeats allowed

Boss.description: Step in to advance to the Boss fight

Elite.description: Start: draw 2 unique rewards; adds tier 3/4 monsters

GoDown.description: Step on to head down a Floor

GoUp.description: Step on to head up a Floor

ItemReward.description: 2 stat + 3 random items; click to take, leave to pass

Leave.description: Step on to leave the current room

TreasureReward.description: 1 chest + 3 random items; click to take, leave to pass

avatar.default.faceIntro: Delves the dungeon, hungry for glory.

deck.ai_expansion.description: Temporary holding for AI expansion content (for review): Forge Legion x5, Tide Vortex x5, traps x5, items x5, relics x5. Split per design doc once approved.

deck.help_archive.description: Retired Item Cards kept for reference (Armor-Breaking Hammer / Blood Conversion / Doubling Tower / Shield Bash Tutorial / Stat Boost / Blessing / Watchtower); excluded from reward pools, item source pools, and room injection.

deck.relic_archive.description: Misfit old Relics kept for reference; excluded from reward pools and grants.

deck.transition.description: Archived (#134): restored staging monsters live here, all isReserve, no longer drawn in real encounters; new monsters go to the seven official decks

help.attack_card.faceIntro: Makes you want to punch a table.

help.blue_chest_card.description: Pick and gain an advanced Relic

help.brutality_card.faceIntro: One day without it hurts all over.

help.common_chest_card.description: Pick and gain a common Relic

help.fireball.description: Deal your [attack] to a chosen monster
help.fireball.faceIntro: A mage open-sourced it, so now everyone casts it.

help.golden_chest_card.description: Pick and gain a superior Relic

help.impact_tutorial.description: Deal your current [HP] as damage to a monster
help.impact_tutorial.faceIntro: A hard head counts as gear.

help.magnet_anchor.description: Move a monster card to the center cell

help.swap_card.description: Pick {help.swap_card.use.count} non-player cards; they trade places

help.teleport_card.description: Shuffle {help.teleport_card.use.count} non-player cards into the deck

monster.brainless_orc.faceIntro: Sneaks in the thicket, spraying webs.

monster.fire_priest.faceIntro: Used to be a seasoned lumberjack.

monster.forge_apprentice.faceIntro: His craft shows on everyone else.

monster.forge_master.description: [[Standard Melee]], on act: all allies +{skill.forge_all.fire.amount}[armor], armor breaks splash {skill.forge_spatter.break.amount}
monster.forge_master.faceIntro: While the forge burns, iron stands.

monster.forge_shell_turtle.faceIntro: Shell broke; patience went with it.

monster.forge_sunder_warrior.description: [[Standard Melee]], on act: {skill.forge_sunder.fire.amount} [[Piercing]] damage to [adjacent] player

monster.pickpocket.faceIntro: Outshot the Shortbow Skeleton at the 3rd archery meet.

monster.rogue.faceIntro: Not always a ghost-eyed bag of bones.

monster.skeleton_taunter.faceIntro: Insists he is not in grad school.

monster.skull_head.faceIntro: Ready to give itself, any time.

monster.tide_heart.description: [[Omni Melee]], on act: rotate {skill.tide_surge_fire.fire.count}, allies heal {skill.tide_bloom.fire.amount}

monster.tide_jelly.faceIntro: Drifts with the tide; strikes with it.

monster.tide_ray.description: [[Diagonal Melee]], moved into center: swaps with a random monster

monster.tide_tentacle.description: [[Standard Melee]], on act: lashes player for {skill.tide_reel.fire.amount}

monster.veteran_orc.faceIntro: Sneaks closer when you're not looking.

monster.wandering_child.faceIntro: No muscles, big axe. A true mystery.

relic.beyond_dimension.faceIntro: Punch, then see the world anew.

relic.blood_burst.description: [MHP]+{relic.blood_burst.max_hp.value}; when hurt: reflect to a random monster
relic.blood_burst.faceIntro: You bleed, it holds the grudge.

relic.blood_cycle.faceIntro: Spill a little, it pours some back.

relic.blood_regen.faceIntro: Only works when you look pale.

relic.body_potential.description: [MHP]+{relic.body_potential.max_hp.value}; per {relic.body_potential.hp_lost.threshold}[HP] lost, add {relic.body_potential.hp_lost.count} items to deck

relic.composite_armor.faceIntro: Muscles bluff; the armor means it.

relic.foam_armor.description: [B_armor]+{relic.foam_armor.base.value}; first armor break each Combat grants [[Damage Shield]]

relic.forge_bracer.faceIntro: Broken armor fuels the hammer arm.

relic.forge_tool.description: Base [armor]+{relic.forge_tool.init.value}; Combat start: eats {relic.forge_tool.node_start.threshold}[armor], base [armor] permanently +{relic.forge_tool.node_start.delta}
relic.forge_tool.faceIntro: Strip a little, call it an upgrade.

relic.gold_armor.faceIntro: The wallet is a body part too.

relic.gold_knife.faceIntro: Career planning, on a blade's edge.

relic.golden_coffer.description: On pickup: add {relic.golden_coffer.grant.count} Golden Chests to deck

relic.heavy_armor.description: Base [armor]+{relic.heavy_armor.base.value}; Combat start: per {relic.heavy_armor.node_start.every} base [armor], gain {relic.heavy_armor.node_start.gain}[armor]

relic.junk_amplifier.description: Per {relic.junk_amplifier.use.every} Item Cards used: [attack]+{relic.junk_amplifier.use.value} this Combat

relic.junk_coating.faceIntro: Was a Mac Pro in a past life.

relic.junk_cycler.description: Per {relic.junk_cycler.use.threshold} Item Cards used: add {relic.junk_cycler.use.count} Item Cards to deck

relic.junk_launcher.description: Per {relic.junk_launcher.use.every} Item Cards used: {relic.junk_launcher.use.amount} damage to {relic.junk_launcher.use.random} random monsters
relic.junk_launcher.faceIntro: New rubber band; no other warranty.

relic.lucky_coin.description: On Boss kill: add {relic.lucky_coin.boss_kill.count} gold cards to deck

relic.metal_blood.description: When damaged: lost [HP] becomes that much [armor]

relic.potion_bag.description: Combat start: add {relic.potion_bag.node_start.count} Healing Potions to deck
relic.potion_bag.faceIntro: Always one bottle you can't explain.

relic.punch_card_knife.description: [attack]+{relic.punch_card_knife.attack.value}; per {relic.punch_card_knife.remove.threshold} kills: add {relic.punch_card_knife.remove.count} regular Item Cards to deck
relic.punch_card_knife.faceIntro: Every harvest drops a little extra.

relic.rotation_button.description: Combat start: put {relic.rotation_button.node_start.count} Rotation Wheels in hand
relic.rotation_button.faceIntro: Stare too long and the floor moves.

relic.rotation_trick.description: Per {relic.rotation_trick.remove.threshold} monster kills: add {relic.rotation_trick.remove.count} Rotation Wheels to deck
relic.rotation_trick.faceIntro: Spin long enough, the world tilts.

relic.rotten_cleave_axe.description: [attack]+{relic.rotten_cleave_axe.base.value}; [[Standard Attack]] instead deals {relic.rotten_cleave_axe.cleave.amount} damage to the target's [adjacent] area

relic.slag_recycler.description: Per {relic.slag_recycler.cumulative.threshold}[armor] lost: {relic.slag_recycler.cumulative.amount} damage to a random monster

relic.sling.description: On kill: {relic.sling.kill.amount} damage to {relic.sling.kill.random} random monsters

relic.still_watch.description: Per {relic.still_watch.tick.every} Interactions: all monster action countdowns +{relic.still_watch.tick.delta}
relic.still_watch.faceIntro: Press the hand; the world slows.

relic.swap_button.description: Combat start: put {relic.swap_button.node_start.count} Swaps in hand

relic.terror_mask.description: [attack]+{relic.terror_mask.attack.value}; per {relic.terror_mask.remove.threshold} kills this Combat: destroy {relic.terror_mask.remove.count} random regular monsters

relic.thorn_mail.description: Base [armor]+{relic.thorn_mail.base.value}; [armor] you lose is dealt back to the attacker
relic.thorn_mail.faceIntro: The best defense hurts them too.

relic.throwing_knife_bag.description: Combat start: add {relic.throwing_knife_bag.node_start.count} Throwing Knives to deck

relic.tide_compass.faceIntro: One needle turn, one wound closed.

relic.trap_cell.description: A monster moving to cell {relic.trap_cell.move.slot} takes {relic.trap_cell.move.amount} damage

skill.absorb.description: When an adjacent monster is removed: random buff to this card

skill.absorb_bone.description: When an adjacent monster is removed: gain its attack and armor

skill.absorb_stone.description: Each move: drain all armor from adjacent monsters

skill.air_strike.description: Moving to a corner cell: deal 2 damage to the player

skill.ambush_melee.description: [On Board] At the card fire window: if face-up and orthogonally adjacent to the player, [Flip]

skill.assassin_leader.description: [On Board] While this card is face-up: monsters flip face-down right after being played

skill.attrition.description: When a monster is removed: this card attack -1, HP -10

skill.battle_hardened.description: [In Combat] Per 2 total damage dealt to the player: this card attack +1

skill.beggar_bond.description: Every 5 moves: shuffle in a Beggar

skill.bloodthirst.description: In Combat: per 2 damage dealt, this card attack +1

skill.call_followers.description: Every 3 moves: a Dragon Follower joins

skill.call_melee6.description: Every 5 Interactions: add a Blue Flame to the combat deck

skill.chant.description: Every 6 Interactions: add a Greatsword Skeleton to the combat deck

skill.cloud_breath.description: Every 5 Interactions: remove all Flames on board, deal damage per Flame

skill.death_summon.description: [On Board] [On Removal]: play a Revive Stone to the same cell

skill.delivery.description: Every 5 moves: swap an adjacent Item Card with a combat-deck monster

skill.endless_flame.description: When a Flame is removed: shuffle in another Flame

skill.evade.description: [After Combat] If cells 1/3/7/9 hold another card: swap with a random one; skips if all empty; skips after lethal damage

skill.fall_apart.description: On removal: shuffle in a Skull Head and a Headless Skeleton

skill.falling_rocks.description: Per 10 armor lost total: shuffle in a Stone Man

skill.fight_me.description: An adjacent player fighting other monsters fights this card instead

skill.find_weakness.description: After Blessed Ground reaches 3: the next move deals 99 damage

skill.fire_power.description: Per Flame on board: this card attack +2

skill.first_strike.description: Holds the First Strike counter skill

skill.flame_boiling.description: [On Board] Per 5 player Interactions: Flame damage +1 (stacks)

skill.flame_breath.description: Every 4 moves: remove other normal monsters, add that many Flames

skill.fracture_fall_apart.description: On removal: shuffle in a Multi-Bone Worm and a random tier-2 monster

skill.gear_delivery.description: Every 2 moves: random buff to another monster

skill.gift.description: Every 3 moves: place a Rotation Wheel

skill.give_punch.description: Entering on an even edge cell: damage the player

skill.guide.description: Every 3 moves: create Blessed Ground; monsters entering it gain armor and attack

skill.hard.description: Fighting in the left column: damage the player per armor lost

skill.holy_duel.description: [On Board] [After Combat] with this card: fighting other monster cards deals 2 damage to the player; the mark clears when the holder flips or leaves

skill.hoodlum.description: Each move to cell 1: deal 2 damage to the player

skill.hot_observation.description: A monster card displaced by monster skills: damage the player

skill.intense_burning.description: Each Flame added to the combat deck adds one more, no recursion

skill.leap_kill.description: [On Board] [After Flip] If face-up and orthogonally adjacent to the player: deal this card's attack to the player

skill.learning_growth.description: When another monster gains attack: this card attack +1

skill.link_attack_bonus.description: With another monster adjacent: attack damage +1

skill.link_prep.description: Every 5 Interactions: remove adjacent Item Cards

skill.link_tactics.description: [On Board] Adjacent monsters attack +1; ends when adjacency breaks (persistent aura)

skill.lord_of_death.description: [On Board] Per monster card [On Removal]: play a Revive Stone to the same cell (its own death excluded)

skill.mixed_bones.description: Every 5 moves: remove 2 random other monsters, shuffle in random tier-2/3 monsters

skill.otherworld_help.description: Every 9 moves: a normal monster joins from another monster deck

skill.purge_followers.description: Every 2 moves: remove all Dragon Followers from the grid

skill.random_walk.description: Every 3 moves: swap with a random Item Card

skill.range_expand.description: All monster cards count as orthogonally adjacent to this card

skill.ranged_weapon.description: [In Combat] When the player engages this card: no first strike, no counter (volleys unaffected)

skill.rascality.description: Per 3 armor lost: adjacent monsters attack +1

skill.recombine_body.description: Combines with an adjacent Headless Skeleton

skill.recombine_head.description: Combines with an adjacent Skull Head

skill.recuperate.description: [On Board] [After Flip] If face-up: this card attack +1, armor +2

skill.relentless_chase.description: Moving adjacent to the player: forces Combat

skill.rise_up.description: [On Board] After this card damages the player: flip a random other face-up monster face-down

skill.rolling_crush.description: Moving to cell 3: remove cell 6's Item Card

skill.sacrifice.description: [On Board] [On Removal]: other monster cards on board attack +1

skill.sharp_stone.description: When armor hits 0: damage the player

skill.smart.description: Whenever it gains attack: +1 extra, no recursion

skill.space_mastery.description: After the player fights this card: rotate once

skill.speed_up.description: [On Board] Each time this card damages the player: other monster cards' Interaction count +1 (countdown -1)

skill.steal.description: [On Board] [After Flip] If face-up: remove a random Item Card on an adjacent cell

skill.stocking.description: On the 3rd cumulative move adjacent to the player: remove an Item Card and gain armor

skill.stone_growth.description: Moving to the left column: other monsters gain 2 armor

skill.stone_lover.description: When the player or a monster loses armor: this card attack +1

skill.stone_shelter.description: Other monster cards take 1 less damage

skill.stray_cub.description: In cell 6: attack +2 and gains First Strike

skill.strong_combo.description: On move: fuses with 2 adjacent monsters into a Giant Skeleton

skill.swallow_stone.description: Every 2 moves: drain adjacent monsters' armor

skill.taunt.description: While adjacent: the player may only fight this card

skill.throw_stone.description: Every 2 moves: spend 2 of this card's armor, damage the player

skill.violence_maniac.description: Every 2 moves: remove monster and Item Cards on adjacent cells

skill.violence_nutrition.description: Via Violence Maniac: removed monsters grant attack, removed Item Cards grant armor

skill.world_as_neighbors.description: [On Board] All monster cards count as orthogonally adjacent (skill adjacency only; attack range unaffected)

trap.echo_bell.description: After Combat with this card: board rotates {trap.echo_bell.battle.count}

trap.flame.description: Per {trap.flame.move.every} moves: {trap.flame.move.amount} damage to [adjacent] player; [death] after {trap.flame.remove.every}

trap.gold_magnet.description: Per {trap.gold_magnet.drain.every} Interactions: drains {trap.gold_magnet.drain.amount}[money]; refunds {trap.gold_magnet.refund.delta}[money] on removal
trap.gold_magnet.faceIntro: Always coughs the money back up.

trap.leave.description: Magic immune; breaks only in Combat. On [death]: leave the room

trap.offering_altar.description: After Combat with this card: a random monster takes {trap.offering_altar.battle.amount} damage
trap.offering_altar.faceIntro: The altar picks its own offerings.

trap.recovery_totem.description: Per {trap.recovery_totem.heal_on_move.every} moves: [adjacent] monsters and player restore {trap.recovery_totem.heal_on_move.amount} [HP]

trap.revive_stone.description: [death] after {trap.revive_stone.interact.every}[action]; plays {trap.revive_stone.remove.count} Greatsword Skeletons to this cell

trap.rolling_stone.description: On moving to cell {trap.rolling_stone.slot3.slot}: removes cell {trap.rolling_stone.slot3.targetSlot}'s regular monster/item/trap

trap.spike.description: Per {trap.spike.move.every} moves: [adjacent] monsters and player take {trap.spike.move.amount} damage

trap.storm_totem.description: Per {trap.storm_totem.pulse.every} Interactions: zaps all [adjacent] cards for {trap.storm_totem.pulse.amount}

trap.tutorial.advance.description: Break 2 to reach the next lesson

trap.tutorial.attack.description: Click an adjacent card to attack

trap.tutorial.boss_door.description: The door opens when the Boss dies

trap.tutorial.deal.description: 8 cards fill the board at start
trap.tutorial.deal.faceIntro: All cards come from the deck.

trap.tutorial.door.description: Break that door to leave the room

trap.tutorial.early_leave.description: Leaving early skips the item payout

trap.tutorial.filler.description: A filler trap. Break at will

trap.tutorial.fire.description: At zero it hits anyone in range

trap.tutorial.hp.faceIntro: HP sits on the card corner.

trap.tutorial.hunt.description: Slay the monster to move on

trap.tutorial.item_intro.description: An Item Card is on the board

trap.tutorial.monster_intro.description: A monster is on the board

trap.tutorial.pickup.description: Click adjacent items to take them

trap.tutorial.reposition.description: Break traps to shift the monsters

trap.tutorial.retreat.description: Low on [HP]? Break the door early

trap.tutorial.use_item.description: Drag hand cards to the board center
